## Conclusion

```{r}
#| label: tbl-conclusion
agree |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(alg3, alg2, con3, con2), ~ sprintf("%.2f", .x))) |>
  gt::gt(rowname_col = "method") |>
  gt::tab_spanner("HRS/HCAP Algorithm", c(alg3, alg2)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(stringr::str_c("Consensus panel (n = ", n_consensus, ")"), c(con3, con2)) |>
  gt::cols_label(alg3 = "3-class", alg2 = "Dementia", con3 = "3-class", con2 = "Dementia") |>
  gt::tab_source_note("Survey-weighted kappas (3-class: quadratic weighted). HCAP weights; consensus-panel weights for the consensus comparisons.") |>
  gt::opt_stylize(6, color = "gray") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::px(22), source_notes.font.size = gt::px(14))
```

<div style="font-size: 0.55em; line-height: 1.2;">
- Agreement with the HRS/HCAP Algorithm: the highest 3-class kappa is for `r best_of("alg3")`, and the highest dementia kappa is for `r best_of("alg2")`. PMM `r f2(kappa_of("PMM", "alg3"))` and `r f2(kappa_of("PMM", "alg2"))`; Core algorithm `r f2(kappa_of("Core algorithm", "alg3"))` and `r f2(kappa_of("Core algorithm", "alg2"))`; Langa-Weir `r f2(kappa_of("Langa-Weir", "alg3"))` and `r f2(kappa_of("Langa-Weir", "alg2"))`.
- Class shares: the PMM probabilities average to `r shares_text(pmm_prob_shares)` (HRS/HCAP Algorithm `r shares_text(ref_shares)`). Assigning each participant to the most likely class gives `r shares_text(pmm_modal_shares)`, `r if (pmm_modal_shares[2] < ref_shares[2]) "which undercounts MCI" else "which does not undercount MCI"`. The probabilities, not the assigned classes, carry the PMM's information.
- The consensus comparisons rest on `r n_consensus` participants, so those kappas are imprecise.
- All agreement is in-sample: the PMM was calibrated, and the Core algorithm's cut points were selected, in the same HRS/HCAP sample. Both are likely optimistic.
</div>
